meta.title: Pixel parity
meta.description: Aligns a repository's frontend with a design image, reference page, Figma frame, or prototype: detects the dev server and routes, compares geometry, computed styles, and masked pixels per case and viewport, tunes tolerances per run, keeps approved baselines, and supports interaction steps, storageState captured by parity_login, settle waits, and iframe anchors. Adds parity_init, parity_run, parity_diagnose, parity_align, parity_report, parity_approve, parity_check, and parity_login, plus a PP panel in the session header. parity_align turns a failed run into an executable plan (geometry, styles, structure, mock data, pixels) that the agent executes automatically, including creating fixtures for layout checks. Exports IR, QML, and component HTML/CSS for inspection. Requires a local Chromium or Playwright (qmlscene optional); artifacts go to .parity/.
